563:t_022:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「This is $$ガンバスター$$, turned into a flame!」

563:t_022:2.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The invincible power that protects humanity!」

563:t_022:4.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I kept you waiting, didn't I, $$ノリコ$$.」

563:t_022:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「No! Being able to meet you again like this, Big Sis, is all that matters! I forgot every sad and painful thing!」

563:t_022:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「Your Big Sis... isn't she already an aun-」

563:t_022:9.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Heh heh... to you kids, it wouldn't be strange to be called 'Auntie,' would it.」

563:t_022:10.en:
$$カズミ$$
「But my body right now is the one I had back when I first piloted $$ガンバスター$$ with $$ノリコ$$.」

563:t_022:11.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes! Big Sis is exactly the way she was back when she was called the Queen of Roses!」

563:t_022:14.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Swallowed by the black hole and thrown out of $$ガンバスター$$, I wished to see $$ノリコ$$ again... to fight beside her...」

563:t_022:15.en:
$$カズミ$$
「And that wish crossed space-time and made my body be born anew.」

563:t_022:16.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So the $$バスター軍団$$ answered that wish and went to bring $$ノリコ$$'s Big Sis back!」

563:t_022:17.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「So the $$バスター軍団$$ answered that wish and went to bring $$ノリコ$$'s Big Sis back!」

563:t_022:18.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「So the $$バスター軍団$$ answered that wish and went to bring $$ノリコ$$'s Big Sis back!」

563:t_022:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The mystery of the universe, indeed!」

563:t_022:20.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... I've lived a long time, yet lately I keep getting surprised.」

563:t_022:21.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「This is a miracle brought about by Big Sis's feelings!」

563:t_022:23.en:
$$オルソン$$
「So human will controlled a phenomenon...」

563:t_022:24.en:
$$桂$$
「Not bad at all! I'm all for this kind of thing!」

563:t_022:25.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Big Sis... You'll fight alongside $$ノリコ$$ again, won't you.」

563:t_022:26.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Of course I will, $$ノリコ$$.」

563:t_022:27.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then we're going! $$ラルク$$, you too, with us!」

563:t_023:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「With Big Sis and me together, there's nothing to be afraid of!」

563:t_023:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「And no matter where we are, there's only one thing for us to do!」

563:t_023:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$, turned into a flame, is humanity's hope!」

563:t_023:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
(Long, beautiful hair, a knockout figure, a Madonna's smile... That's...)

563:t_023:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(Long, beautiful hair, a knockout figure, a Madonna's smile... That's...)

563:t_023:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(Long, beautiful hair, a knockout figure, a Madonna's smile... That's...)

563:t_024:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「No... This is the start of a new fight for Big Sis and me.」

563:t_025:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...This is ridiculous... That something this convenient could happen...」

563:t_025:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「What a hardheaded boy. Just like some boring adult.」

563:t_025:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ニコラ$$... I can understand how you feel. But people have to become adults someday.」

563:t_025:9.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Do you think a platitude like that will convince me?」

563:t_025:10.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Coming from someone with power like yours, it can only sound like sarcasm.」

563:t_025:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...Even if my $$ニュータイプ$$ ability has declined since I was sixteen?」

563:t_025:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's only a vague sense, but I'm aware of it. It's probably the result of carrying needless baggage and no longer being able to take what's in front of me at face value.」

563:t_025:14.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You mean because you became an adult...?」

563:t_025:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I'm confident that I'm far stronger now than I was back then.」

563:t_025:16.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's true. I can vouch for that.」

563:t_025:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ニコラ$$... Even if you're no longer a $$トップレス$$, you're still you.」

563:t_025:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If you have the will to fight, there must be plenty of ways to grow stronger.」

563:t_025:19.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...As I thought, you're an outsider. You understand nothing about $$トップレス$$es.」

563:t_025:21.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But my pride won't let me end like this, as a loser.」

563:t_025:23.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Don't worry, Princess. I'll never lose my head like that again.」

563:t_025:24.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Maybe a miracle like the one $$ノリコ$$'s Big Sis got will happen to me, after all.」

563:t_025:25.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Don't forget, $$ニコラ$$. Miracles aren't something that happens to you, they're something you make happen.」

563:t_025:26.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Even words like that give me some comfort right now.」

563:t_025:27.en:
$$ノノ$$
「If you can crack a joke like that, I'm no longer worried.」

563:t_025:28.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「If you can crack a joke like that, I'm no longer worried.」

563:t_025:29.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「If you can crack a joke like that, I'm no longer worried.」

563:t_025:34.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Sorry about that. Forget about today.」

563:t_025:38.en:
$$タケル$$
「I don't really get it, but looks like it's all settled.」

563:t_025:40.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Good work to you too, $$ラルク$$. I saw it, your hard work and guts.」

563:t_025:41.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It was nothing like that... It's just that... $$ディスヌフ$$ told me to help you guys...」

563:t_025:42.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I was happy anyway... Thank you, $$ラルク$$.」

uncertain: 563:t_022:8/9: Kallen's cut-off オバ(サン) rendered 'aun-' / 'Auntie' to keep the truncation.
563:t_022:11: バラの女王 = 'Queen of Roses' (no precedent in finished slices).
563:t_022:16-18: お姉さまさん (Nono's doubled honorific) read as Noriko's Kazumi = 'Noriko's Big Sis'; バスター軍団 = $$バスター軍団$$ token.
563:t_023:3-5: Nono's thought 'That's...' left open-ended as in the Japanese; unclear whether she is comparing Kazumi to Noriko.
563:t_025:2-4: Nono/BM7/Diebuster katakana オカエリナサイ… rendered as plain 'Welcome back...'.
